<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Thomas Cook Group#Collapse|Collapse of Thomas Cook]]
**[[Germany|German]] airline [[Condor (airline)|Condor]], a [[subsidiary]] of the now [[insolvent]] [[Thomas Cook Group]], files for [[bankruptcy]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49824427 (BBC News)]
**[[Secretary of State for Transport]] [[Grant Shapps]] announces that the [[Government of the United Kingdom|UK government]] is planning to introduce new legislation in the aftermath of Thomas Cook's collapse in order to allow "more orderly" bankruptcies by travel agencies and airlines. [https://news.sky.com/story/thomas-cook-calls-for-new-laws-in-light-of-ridiculous-situation-11819254 (Sky News)]
*[[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] bus manufacturer [[Wrightbus]] collapses into administration after buyout talks fail, with 1,200 jobs lost. Local politicians urge action from [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]], who commissioned the so-called "[[New Routemaster|Boris Bus]]" from the company when he was [[Mayor of London]] and previously promised to "do everything we can to ensure the future of" Wrightbus. [https://news.sky.com/story/routemaster-maker-wrightbus-collapse-places-1-400-jobs-at-risk-11819140 (Sky News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[search and rescue|Rescuers]] reach the wreckage of a [[Twin Otter]] cargo plane that crashed last week between [[Timika]] and [[Ilaga]] in [[Papua_(province)|Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. All four persons on board are found dead, and their bodies are recovered. [https://www.themalaysianinsight.com/s/185725 (The Malaysian Insight)]

;Health and environment
*[[Climate change mitigation]]
**An advisory board to the [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Dutch government|government]] recommends reducing speed limits on roads and using public money to purchase outdated cattle farms as part of a raft of measures to tackle [[global warming]]-linked nitrogen emissions in the country. [https://www.apnews.com/c4865d774bf745fe8d74b236917cff17 (Associated Press)]
*[[Economy of Poland]]
**[[Ministry of Energy (Poland)|Polish Energy Minister]] [[Krzysztof Tchórzewski]] announces the ruling [[Law and Justice (Poland)|Law and Justice]] party plans to pass new laws to enable [[Coal mining in Poland|more coal mines]] to be built. [http://euronews.com/2019/09/25/poland-plans-new-coal-mines-despite-eus-call-for-carbon-neutrality (Reuters via Euronews)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Kiribati]]
**[[President of Kiribati|Kiribatian President]] [[Taneti Mamau]] condemns [[Australia]] for the alleged apathy the [[Australian government]] shows toward [[Small Island Developing States|small island nations]] in the Pacific facing [[Effects of global warming|the threat]] of [[global warming]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399535/kiribati-president-pans-australia-for-climate-apathy (RNZ)]

;Law and crime
*A bomb explodes as a police [[riot van|riot bus]] passes by in [[Yüreğir]], [[Adana Province]], [[Turkey]]. At least five officers are injured. [http://bianet.org/english/human-rights/213509-explosion-while-riot-police-service-vehicle-passing-in-adana-5-people-wounded (Bianet)]
*[[Cannabis in Australia]]
**The [[Australian Capital Territory]] (ACT) becomes the first jurisdiction in [[Australia]] to legalize the recreational use of [[Cannabis (drug)|cannabis]]. From January 31, 2020, adults within ACT will be allowed to have 50 grams of the drug and can grow up to four cannabis plants at home. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-49820735 (BBC News)]
*Millionaire [[Italy|Italian]] yacht businessman Giulio Lolli is convicted of [[terrorism]] in [[Libya]] and sentenced to [[life imprisonment]] by a court in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. Lolli is wanted for fraud in Italy, and his Italian lawyer says the Libyan legal case appears to be based on Lolli using a yacht to evacuate fighters from Tripoli. [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/italian-playboy-giulio-lolli-jailed-for-terror-in-libya-f3mg7fzs2 (''The Times'')] <!--A non-paywall source would be better, but all details are sourced to the readable extract for the time being until a better source is found-->
*A jury in [[New York State|New York]] convicts Dilkhayot Kasimov, a citizen of [[Uzbekistan]], of terrorism offences for attempting to raise funds to assist a friend in travelling to join [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. Five others pleaded guilty in 2015. [https://www.apnews.com/b00f266984454143a90bee7f2d479878 (Associated Press)]
*Suspected [[serial killer]] [[Gracious David-West]] confesses to fifteen murders at a hotel in [[Port Harcourt]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/25/man-confesses-killing-15-women-port-harcourt-hotel-murders-rocked/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*The military court in [[Blida]] sentences [[Mohamed Mediène]], {{ill|Said Bouteflika|ar|سعيد_بوتفليقة|fr|Saïd Bouteflika}}, {{ill|Bachir Tartag|ar|بشير_طرطاق|fr|Athmane Tartag}} and [[Louisa Hanoune]], four persons from the ruling elite around former [[President of Algeria|Algerian President]] [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]], to 15-year jail terms for conspiracy against the [[Algerian People's National Army|army]] and the authority of the [[Algeria]]n state. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-trial/algeria-jails-top-figures-of-bouteflika-era-idUSKBN1WA07P (Reuters)]
*[[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] issues an [[Impeachment in the United States|impeachment inquiry]] into [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-impeachment-inquiry-09-25-2019/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Danske Bank money laundering scandal]]
**Authorities raid the [[Germany|German]] bank [[Deutsche Bank]] as part of a [[money laundering]] probe into [[euro|€]]200 billion of suspicious payments identified into the accounts of [[Danske Bank]]'s branch in [[Estonia]]. Danske Bank's Estonian boss from 2007 to 2015 is found dead near [[Tallinn]] at his home in circumstances police describe as neither suspicious nor accidental. [https://www.cityam.com/dutch-bank-abn-amro-probed-under-terror-financing-rules/ (City A.M.)]
*A federal [[grand jury]] indicts a [[US Army]] soldier on charges of distributing explosives information as part of an alleged [[far-right terror]] plot. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/25/politics/army-soldier-indicted-alleged-bombing-news-network/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[September 2019 Israeli legislative election]]
**[[Israeli President]] [[Reuven Rivlin]] formally gives [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] the mandate to form the next [[Israeli government]] by October 24, after 55 members of the [[Knesset]] recommended the latter, compared with 54 recommendations for [[Benny Gantz]]. If Netanyahu fails, the mandate could be transferred to Gantz. [https://www.jpost.com/Israel-Elections/Rivlin-meeting-with-Netanyahu-Gantz-602868 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[Soyuz-MS]] spacecraft ''[[Soyuz MS-15|Sarmat]]'', carrying [[Hazza Al Mansouri]], the first [[United Arab Emirates]] [[astronaut]], and [[Expedition 61]] crew members [[Jessica Meir]] and [[Oleg Skripochka]], is launched to the [[International Space Station]]. It was the final flight of the [[Soyuz-FG]] launch vehicle – all future Soyuz MS spacecraft launches will be conducted with the [[Soyuz-2]]. [https://spaceflightnow.com/2019/09/25/soyuz-ms-15-launch-mission-status-center/ (Spaceflight Now)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/soyuz-rocket-launch-today-watch-live-stream-soyuz-flight-international-space-station-uae-guest-cosmonaut-2019-09-25/ (CBS News)]
